name: skillforge
description: SkillForge monorepo — apps/web (Next.js) and apps/api (Express + Prisma). Root scripts delegate to each app with npm --prefix; each app keeps its own package.json and lockfile.
author: V. Saatwik Sairaam

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
